statement.text:
Let Rpk be the variety of class 2 nilpotent groups of exponent pk , where p is
a prime number and k ⩾ 2. It is true that for every p and k there are infinitely many
subquasivarieties of Rpk each of which is generated by a finite group with derived
subgroup of exponent pk and does not have an independent basis of quasi-identities?
                                                                              A. I. Budkin
